synopsis: VMAD stands for Validation Method for Automated Driving and is an informal group under GRVA [f15392]. It developed UNECE’s New Assessment/Test Method (NATM) framework, a finding repeated in Chapter 2 and the glossary [f1281, f15392]. The glossary places VMAD within the on-road UN vehicle-regulation structure, distinguishing WP.29 as the forum, GRVA as the working party, VMAD as the expert group and NATM as the method [f15389]. These facts establish VMAD’s role in an on-road assessment precedent, but provide no dates, implementation timelines or explicit applicability to heavy off-road machines [f1281, f15389, f15392].

relations.note: Both identify VMAD as the developer of NATM.
Expands VMAD’s name and specifies its informal status under GRVA.
Places VMAD and NATM within the broader UN road-vehicle regulatory structure.
